SharedVault.title: SharedVault
SharedVault.description: Shared gratitude vault preferences gated exclusively to alan.rodmell@gmail.com and jlmclaren84@gmail.com.

createdBy.description: UID of the allowlisted member who initialized the vault.

meLabel.description: Display label for entries I am grateful for about her.

herLabel.description: Display label for entries she is grateful for about me.

reminderEnabled.description: Whether daily reflection reminders are enabled.

reminderTime.description: Daily reminder time in HH:mm 24-hour format.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the vault was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when preferences were last updated.

GratitudeEntry.title: GratitudeEntry
GratitudeEntry.description: A single 500-character gratitude note rendered as a white or brown kraft gift tag.

id.description: Unique identifier for the gratitude tag.

authorUid.description: UID of the allowlisted member who created this entry.

text.description: The gratitude note text, up to 500 characters.

perspective.description: Whether this is something I am grateful for about her, or she is grateful for about me.

tagStyle.description: Visual gift tag cardstock template: white ivory or brown kraft paper.

tags.description: Personal category tags for navigation (bounded to 8 tags max).

entryDate.description: Date of the gratitude memory in YYYY-MM-DD format.

isFavorite.description: Whether the entry is starred for quick reflection.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the entry was last modified.

MemberReadState.title: MemberReadState
MemberReadState.description: Tracks the last timestamp when an allowlisted member viewed new partner tags.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the member.

lastSeenMs.description: Unix epoch milliseconds of the last acknowledged check for new partner entries.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the member read state was updated.

/vaults/{vaultId}.description: Shared gratitude vault preferences gated to alan.rodmell@gmail.com and jlmclaren84@gmail.com.

/vaults/{vaultId}/entries/{entryId}.description: Subcollection storing synced gratitude gift tag entries for the two allowlisted partners.

/vaults/{vaultId}/members/{memberId}.description: Per-member read state tracking unseen tags created by the other partner.
